finding: The multi-leg broker validates one shared intent event_id per bundle, but sizes the event cap and persists LegState.event_id from each fetched Market.event_id. Gamma /markets/{id} can omit event metadata, causing the C++ parser to fall back to condition_id. This fragments one economic event across condition-level risk buckets.
required_successor_contract: Persist a canonical risk_event_id independently from condition_id and independently from any research-cluster key.
For Graph/RV, require every leg to bind to the single validated event_id already carried by the bundle intent; fail closed on a contradictory fetched event id.

For Local Factor/PCA pairs spanning multiple events, derive and persist each leg's canonical Polymarket event identity from point-in-time discovery/event metadata and fail closed when unavailable rather than falling back to condition_id for event concentration.
Compute max_event_fraction against canonical event identities for both resting reservation and filled exposure.
Add a deterministic multi-bundle regression proving multiple conditions from one event cannot collectively exceed the event cap while each condition bucket stays below it.
Do not change the authorized paper envelope or any authenticated/real-money boundary as part of this audit.
